title: Enhanced Biomes Music
description: Improves soundtrack playback in biomes, adds an Intelligent Playback System in Mountain and Cave biomes — something that was so missing in Minecraft. Check out the description to see what else the mod improves.

[![Banner Forge](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ea807715d33949e0c14421262b700e073adefe04_0.webp)
](https://modrinth.com/mod/enhancedbiomemusic/versions?l=forge)
[![Quilt](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/47081363ba455c5d2ccbc01e73117495ed6d10c3.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/enhancedbiomemusic/versions?l=quilt)

****
> **This mod improves Soundtrack playback in biomes by implementing the vanilla Intelligent Playback System. Specifically, this applies to the following biomes: Stony Peaks, Jagged Peaks, Frozen Peaks, Grove, Snowy Slopes, Dripstone Caves, Lush Caves, Deep Dark, and Sulfur Caves. Each of these biomes has its own delay before music playback begins. This means that upon entering these biomes, players can immediately hear the Soundtracks and enjoy the views of the Mountains and Caves along with the Soundtracks of the Mountain and Cave biomes.**

<details>
<summary>Intelligent Playback System:</summary>
  
> **How it works:**
> 
> **When you first enter these biomes, the music will start playing with a delay of 1 to 15 seconds, depending on the biome. However, this delay does not trigger every time you enter these biomes. Here's how it works:**
> 
>- **Upon first entering a biome, the delay triggers after 1–15 seconds.**
> 
>- **The music ends, and the 1 to 15 second delays are temporarily blocked for a short period.**
> 
>- **The block expires, and the 1 to 15 second delays can trigger again.**
> 
> **This is designed to prevent the delays from happening too frequently, and to keep the music from playing too often.**
> 
-  ### Biomes where this Intelligent Playback System works:

> **Lockouts appear only if the 1–15 second delays have actually triggered in these biomes. To explain in more detail: suppose a 5‑second delay triggers in the Dripstone Caves. Then, after the music ends — and only if the music actually played specifically because of that 5‑second delay — a 24‑minute lockout is created for other cave and mountain biomes, as well as for the Dripstone Caves themselves. If the music in the Dripstone Caves plays again 7 minutes later, this lockout will not refresh. Instead, the lockout will simply continue expiring, and now there will be only 17 minutes remaining until the lockout ends. This is for those who did not understand how the lockout works!**
